validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED, high confidence. This is a real, small (1,500 ft / 0.46 km), 36-inch, FERC-jurisdictional US-Mexico border crossing segment built by El Paso Natural Gas Co. (EPNG, a Kinder Morgan subsidiary) at El Paso County, Texas, authorized under FERC Docket No. CP12-96-000 (application filed Mar 22, 2012 per EPNG's own filing hosted at rextag.com; FERC Federal Register notice of intent to prepare an EA published May 18, 2012, docs.gov/govinfo.gov). FERC approved putting the facility into service on/around June 14, 2013 (EIA Natural Gas Weekly Update, week ending June 19 2013) and NGI reported the startup approval June 18, 2013, matching the sheet's StartYear1=2013. Three genuinely independent sources (NGI trade press, FERC's own Federal Register notice, and EIA's weekly government report) all agree on: 1,500 ft / 36-inch pipe (=0.46 km, matches sheet exactly), 366 MMcf/d capacity (EIA rounds to 0.37 Bcf/d, consistent), El Paso County TX origin, and delivery to the Tarahumara Pipeline interconnect at the border feeding Mexican CFE power plants in Chihuahua/Durango/Coahuila. No evidence of decommissioning, conversion, or capacity change found in a 2024-2025 search sweep -- status=operating remains reasonable. CLASSIFICATION: correctly scoped as a discrete border-crossing segment/cluster distinct from the downstream Tarahumara Gas Pipeline (a separate Mexico-side system, not in GEM's US roster) -- no duplicate risk against any of the other 45 roster rows; nothing else in the roster resembles this crossing. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1='Kinder Morgan' 100% is consistent with all three sources, which describe the builder/operator as 'Kinder Morgan's El Paso Natural Gas Co.' -- not contested, but Operator (currently blank) should be filled with the named operating entity El Paso Natural Gas Company, L.L.C. (see fills[]). SPEC: Length, Diameter, and Capacity all verified exactly against two-to-three independent primary/near-primary sources -- no discrepancy. Opened and read to exhaustion: the NGI startup article, the FERC Federal Register NOI/EA scoping notice (govinfo.gov PDF), the EIA Natural Gas Weekly Update archive, and EPNG's own Mar-2012 application letter (hosted by Rextag) -- all 4 of the leads reachable from this row (3 harvested wiki citations + 1 found via web search for the docket number); the EIA generic 'naturalgas/data.php' portal page and the Kinder Morgan pipeportal.kindermorgan.com system-constraints page (both harvested citations) do NOT name Norte Crossing specifically and were excluded as unverifiable per-pipeline refs.
